result.summary: Gross margin fell by 56,693.30 (-8.38%), from 676,566.20 in 2026-08 to 619,872.90 in 2026-09. The change is concentrated in product=Rain Jacket (58%, lift 3.03x). Other contributors moved roughly in line with their size: product=Air Purifier (20%), product=Coffee Maker (9%). For product=Rain Jacket the largest effect is unit cost (28,198.38). The USD/CAD exchange rate averaged 1.3289 in the base month and 1.333 in the compare month (+0.31%). That is too small to explain the change. No concentrated driver was found by channel, region.

claims.statement: product=Rain Jacket fell by 33,017.43, which is 58% of the total change (lift 3.03x: it moved faster than its size predicts). Mechanism: volume effect 4,345.85 (negative), price effect 473.20 (negative), unit cost effect 28,198.38 (negative) (unit cost changed 19.97%; average price changed -0.18%; units changed -3.34%).

product=Air Purifier fell by 11,480.77, which is 20% of the total change (lift 0.87x: roughly in line with its size). Mechanism: volume effect 7,536.32 (negative), price effect 195.10 (positive), unit cost effect 4,139.55 (negative) (unit cost changed 1.36%; average price changed 0.04%; units changed -4.77%).

product=Coffee Maker fell by 5,171.45, which is 9% of the total change (lift 0.64x: roughly in line with its size). Mechanism: volume effect 1,958.85 (negative), price effect 707.83 (negative), unit cost effect 2,504.77 (negative) (unit cost changed 1.84%; average price changed -0.31%; units changed -2.03%).

ruled_out.why: proportional: 'Online' holds 42% of the change but its size alone predicts that (lift 0.94)
proportional: 'Online' holds 44% of the change but its size alone predicts that (lift 0.96)
diffuse: largest same-direction member 'Quebec' holds 40% of the scope change

caveats: The decomposition shows which segments moved and by how much; it cannot identify business causes (pricing, campaigns, supply) that are not in the data.

recalled.content: Why gross margin changed in September 2026 versus August 2026 (2026-08->2026-09): product=Rain Jacket accounted for 58% of the change (delta -33,017.43); dominant mechanism: unit cost effect.

Why gross margin changed in September 2026 versus August 2026 (2026-08->2026-09): dimension channel (scope (all)) was ruled out as a driver (proportional: 'Online' holds 42% of the change but its size alone predicts that ).

Why gross margin changed in September 2026 versus August 2026 (2026-08->2026-09): dimension region (scope product=Rain Jacket) was ruled out as a driver (diffuse: largest same-direction member 'Quebec' holds 40% of the scope change).
